rejected.was: docs/docs/cmd/external/connection/connection-add.mdx:46-51: ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy is an application-only permission in Microsoft Graph — it has no delegated authentication support. Listing it under the Delegated tab will mislead users into thinking they can use this command with delegated (user) credentials. rejected.why: The claim that ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy is application-only is factually incorrect. The project's own mock data (app-permission-list.mock.ts) shows two entries for this permission: one Application-scoped (origin: Application) and one delegated-scoped (with userConsentDescription/userConsentDisplayName and type: Admin). The permission supports delegated access with admin consent, making the Delegated tab entry accurate.
